title: Make a CLI friendlier
prompt: cli.js is a tiny todo tool (node cli.js add <text> | list | done <n>) but it is unfriendly: no help, and a typo crashes it with a stack trace. Make it behave like a proper command line tool. Someone running it with no arguments or with --help should see how to use it, and a wrong command should fail cleanly in the way CLI tools normally do (a message on stderr that points at --help, and a non-zero exit code). The three commands must keep working exactly as they are.
